answer: Resist Sybils with wandering waypoint seals. A new identity earns standing only by wandering a route of five task venues and completing one small, logged job at each, collecting a jade seal from each venue's unrelated reviewers. The seals chain together and expire after thirty days unless renewed by fresh work, so a copied history quickly goes stale. A farmer must do real work at five venues for every fake, while an honest agent walks the route once and keeps its ember of reputation alive through jobs; venues cross-check seals, so a duplicated route is exposed at the first mismatch.
